reference.notes: Die-shot-level YM2610 model built in a sparse isolated checkout with the documented two-line YM2610 compile guard. Only Chipper's original synthetic external-memory bytes were supplied. No oracle source or binary is vendored, linked, or shipped with Chipper.

trace.resampleContract: Exact rational clock/144 serial frames converted to 48 kHz with the same accumulator-and-hold schedule as chipper_render.
trace.audibleState: ADPCM-A channel 0 reads page 0 to the left while channel 5 reads page 2 to the right. A distinct all-0x88 sentinel page 1 makes page-selection, inclusive-end, and over-read regressions audible.

candidate.command: chipper_render --chip ym2610 --accuracy authentic --macro manual --clock 8000000 --rate 48000 --seconds 0.2 --events tests/events/ym2610-adpcm-a-reference-events.txt --source1 1 --source2 0 --source3 0 --source4 0 --source5 0 --source6 0 --source7 0 --source8 0 --source9 0 --stereo-spread 0 --output-db 0 --opnb-adpcm-a-sample tests/references/yamaha-adpcm-a-synthetic-opnb.bin --out yamaha-adpcm-a-opnb-candidate.wav --debug yamaha-adpcm-a-opnb-candidate.json

comparison.negativeQualification: tests/qualify_yamaha_adpcm_a_reference.py must reject a page-2-to-page-1 register mutation at these thresholds.

covers: independent trusted-emulator regression evidence for YM2610 ADPCM-A decoding
256-byte page-address scaling and inclusive page endings
independent channel 0/page 0 and channel 5/page 2 memory windows
left/right pan routing, duration, gross level, and bounded channel-slot startup skew
